Video frame-by-frame distances

Saved baseline-light dev images are shown for 0.6 seconds each, without audio. Playback speed is chosen for viewing. Distances come from the recorded camera and target coordinates, are shown to two decimal places, and are not supplied to the model.

Range membership uses the unrounded distance and the strict threshold d < R. Being inside the range does not mean a model has stopped.
